Lina: Heads-up — SRE is planning a controlled rollback for the new routing change, want marketing aligned on customer comms and status page wording.
Amit: Thanks, Lina. ETA for rollback window is 21:30–21:45 PT tonight. Rolling back only the routing flag, no data loss.
Tasha: Good to know. We should prepare 1) brief statuspage blurb, 2) email for affected accounts, 3) social snippet if it hits broader customer base.
Jon: Confirmed. We'll start rollback at 21:30, monitor for 30m, then close the incident if stable. If not, escalate to oncall.
Marcos: For email — can we segment by customers on Dedicated and Private? They'll want extra color about isolation and SLA impact.
Amit: Yes — only ~3 dedicated customers hit the fallback route. We can send targeted email to them + public statuspage for everyone.
Lina: Draft statuspage copy attempt: "We detected elevated routing latency after a recent routing config rollout. At 21:30 PT we initiated a rollback of the routing flag to restore normal latency. No customer data was affected. We will provide an update by 22:15 PT." Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Tasha: I like concise. Suggest replacing "elevated routing latency" with "increased inference latency" to be clearer for product teams.
Jon: +1. Also add "clients on Dedicated may have seen intermittent errors" for accuracy.
Lina: Updated statuspage copy: "We detected increased inference latency after a recent routing config rollout. At 21:30 PT we initiated a rollback of the routing flag to restore normal latency. Dedicated customers may have experienced intermittent errors. No customer data was affected. Next update by 22:15 PT."
Marcos: For the targeted email subject: "Redwood Inference — Routing rollback & impact on your Dedicated capacity" Keep body short: what happened, that we're rolling back, any action required (none), contact for help.
Amit: Agreed. We'll include a ticket link and an oncall contact. Also add a short line for partners about expected SLA window.
Lina: OK I'll prepare: 1) statuspage post (public), 2) targeted email draft, 3) a 2-line social post for LinkedIn/Twitter if we need to notify broadly. Need signoff by 21:10 PT so comms go live with rollback timeline.
Jon: We'll ping here at 21:05 with final rollback go/no-go.
deploy-bot: Incident created — ID INC-2026-042. Severity: degraded. Owner: Jon.
Lina: Thanks — I'll queue the copy and share in this thread for rapid signoff. :thumbsup:
